lines.en: What are we cooking for dinner tonight?
Fish soup. Please cut the onions.
Where is the sharp knife?
It's in the drawer next to the stove.
I cut my finger last week. I will be careful.
Good. Put the pan on the stove, please.
Should I get the bowls and spoons?
Yes, and two plates and forks.
This kitchen smells so good already.
Dinner will be on the table in ten minutes.
lines.ko: 십 분 뒤에 저녁이 식탁에 오를 거예요.

lines.en: Grandma, can I help you cook today?
Yes. But the knife is sharp. Be careful.
How do I hold it?
Hold it like this and cut slowly.
I cut a carrot at school last week.
Great. Now put them in the bowl.
Will we cook them in the pan?
Yes. I will turn on the stove. Stand back.
lines.ko: 네. 내가 가스레인지를 켤게요. 뒤로 물러서요.

lines.en: Is it hot? I can't touch it, right?
Right. Only Grandma touches the stove. Good job.
